Former direct spoil (both held AND permit lost) is a subset: STATE_PF is set and read in the same scan (order SPOIL_* -> GATE_PF_SET -> STATE_PF -> GATE_SPOIL_PF -> GATE_029).

v77.cause: E2d item SafeResumption/MODE.OrIn4 := b_Step12 (Q-REL-AFTER-PERMIT, v4) keeps the recognizer (GATE_001) alive during S12, so an attempt armed in Safe survives into R&D; likewise in Run (MODE.OrIn3 b_Step3). The attempt has no memory of the phase in which a button was first pressed; acceptance (GATE_020) only checks the stage at qualification.
v77.fix: NEW GATE_PHASE safeOr (b_Step12, b_Step3) -> GATE_PF_SET.OrIn3: STATE_PF ("attempt not clean") is also set while the stage is S12 (Safe->R&D phase) or S3 (Run, incl. Run->R&D descent before arrival); Reset = RELEASE.TonOut (both released for the full clearing filter, reset-dominant). The attempt is spoiled (STATE_L) only when both buttons are held and STATE_PF is set (v7.6 GATE_SPOIL_PF). No AND with "button held": while released for >= the filter the dominant Reset keeps STATE_PF = 0 (same proof as M-E2b-47/48 equivalence), so a button-free AND would be an unkillable guard.
v77.boundaries: f in phase (A1+10, A1+300, R-1; second after R; hold through R): no SU/C2/STO/Run (c10); f = R: executed (observation row); f = R+1 after >= 2000 ms released: executed (SU f+d+1000+3); repeat after an ignored in-phase gesture released at g: g+1999 and g+2000 ignored, g+2001 accepted; Safe->R&D itself unchanged (R&D at t0+603 in all cases).
v77.reverseDirections: Button-started phases R&D->Safe (stage change at +504) and Run->R&D (at +705) are shorter than the 2 s button clearing, so no attempt can be armed inside them: base already ignores (c10 reverse runs, v7.6 = v7.7). StartingRun is NOT short (V77-A): with HV Faulty (or missing C2_FBK) SU holds indefinitely and a BOTH can be armed inside it. It is still unreachable in E2 because E2 has no exit SU -> R&D: abort by green is E3 (V14-Q12), window rollback is E6 (Q-RC-19), CMD_RUN_TO_R&D is E4 (V14-Q12, V14-Q14); a BOTH begun in SU is qualified in SU/Run and consumed (GATE_030.OrIn5), Emergency resets the recognizer. Hence recRndC_SU would be an unkillable term in E2 and is not added. recRndC_SG: R&D->Safe lasts < 2 s (stage change at +504), not added. Legacy-started Run->R&D (0,1): defect present, fixed by the b_Step3 term (c10).
